SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS dist_ids, MIN(order_ts_utc) AS mn, MAX(order_ts_utc) AS mx
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY status

SELECT o.web_order_id, o.status, o.line_count,
  COUNT(f.sales_line_id) AS lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_lines,
  MAX(s.store_id) AS store_id
FROM fact_web_order o
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28' AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR COUNT(f.sales_line_id) <> o.line_count OR MAX(s.store_id) <> 900

SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS dist_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_helsinki_day,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_ts_utc IS NULL) AS null_ts
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28' AND status <> 'cancelled'
